executor_check_commands.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $out = 'startup-admin-api.out.log'; $err = 'startup-admin-api.err.log'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $out,$err -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'node' -ArgumentList @('app.js','--port','8080','--verbose','--interface') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location) -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; try { $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(60); $ok = $false; do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; if($p.HasExited){ throw 'Admin API process exited before health checks passed' }; try { $r1 = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/' -TimeoutSec 3; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/status' -TimeoutSec 3; if($r1.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $r2.StatusCode -eq 200){ $ok = $true; break }; if($r1.StatusCode -ge 400 -or $r2.StatusCode -ge 400){ throw 'Admin API health check returned status >=400' } } catch { if((Get-Date) -ge $deadline){ throw } } } while((Get-Date) -lt $deadline); if(-not $ok){ throw 'Admin API health checks did not pass before timeout' } } finally { if($p -and -not $p.HasExited){ Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } }"

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $out = 'startup-frontend.out.log'; $err = 'startup-frontend.err.log'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $out,$err -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'node' -ArgumentList @('app.js') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location) -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; try { $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(75); $ok = $false; do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; if($p.HasExited){ throw 'Frontend process exited before health checks passed' }; try { $r1 = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8082/' -TimeoutSec 3; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8082/about' -TimeoutSec 3; if($r1.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $r2.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $r2.Content -and $r2.Content.Length -gt 0){ $ok = $true; break }; if($r1.StatusCode -ge 400 -or $r2.StatusCode -ge 400){ throw 'Frontend health check returned status >=400' } } catch { if((Get-Date) -ge $deadline){ throw } } } while((Get-Date) -lt $deadline); if(-not $ok){ throw 'Frontend health checks did not pass before timeout or /about body was empty' } } finally { if($p -and -not $p.HasExited){ Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } }"

rollback_strategy: Revert the single final execution commit created by the executor.
planning_notes: ImpactReport was treated as authoritative. Source inspection was limited to the reported location ranges plus minimal surrounding context; app.js lines 127-240 and content/feedback/client-feedback.js lines 28-65 were additionally inspected to select /about as the frontend non-static content startup route. No whole-file reads were required beyond small package manifests. Scope expansions: create package-lock.json files for Admin/API, CLI, Common, Export, Ingest, Search, and frontend because npm install on current npm will create them after package.json upgrades and the final working tree must contain only approved files. Utilities package is intentionally not planned for modification because the impact report states optimist 0.6.1 has no newer registry version. Inferred setup commands were added for Common, Ingest, Search, and Export because Chapman CLI and Admin/frontend runtime paths load sibling modules whose dependencies resolve from those package directories. Startup ports and required paths came from user_health_check_urls: Admin API primary / on 8080 plus /api/auth/status, frontend primary / on 8082 plus /about selected from tv-radio-frontend/content/feedback. The run-specific override is encoded: startup health checks require exact 200 and treat any HTTP status >=400 as failure. No plan entry modifies tv-radio-admin/shared-config.js, tv-radio-frontend/config.js, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore, or .claude/skills/gitnexus/**.
